messages:
marta: Heads up — I'm kicking off a deploy for model-route-v3 + feature flag `new-llm-route` in eu-west at 00:15 UTC. Plan: canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holdpoints. Pin stable model v3.2 to traffic-slice 0 until we verify. Any objections?
devin: Ack. Good call pinning. What's the auto-rollback criteria?
marta: Criteria: p99 latency increase > 150ms OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR quality regression in canary eval (prompt-set perf drop > 2%). If any hit, pause and drain to v3.2.
raj: Can we start at 0.5% rather than 1%? Traffic shape late-night is spiky — prefer smaller initial blast. :thinking:
marta: Yup — set as 0.5% canary. deploybot, schedule canary at 00:15 UTC @ 0.5% then step to 5% at +20m if metrics OK.
deploybot: queued rollout `new-llm-route` for model-route-v3 -> steps [0.5%, 5%, 25%, 100%]. Holdpoints=600s. Monitors: p50/p95/p99, 502-rate, overall error-rate, token-cost. Ops notify: @oncall.
oncall: I'll be watching dashboards; please post concise release notes here once canary starts.
sasha: Quick reminder: link to rollback runbook here: https://go/runbooks/ff-rollback (shortlink) — keep it handy.
tanya: I'll enable diff-eval on prompt-sets A,B and alert if regression > 2%.
devin: How are we pinning slices? Example command?
marta: Example deploybot command: `deploybot start --flag new-llm-route --model model-route-v3 --pin-slice 0:v3.2 --steps 0.5,5,25,100 --hold 600`
raj: Will deploybot fallback to the smaller/quantized variant if GPU pressure spikes? Last time fallback didn't engage.
marta: Fallback policy `fallback:on` is set — will route to v3-int8 variant when env pressure/latency breach thresholds. Also added `fallback:grace=30s`.
deploybot: canary started @1725500030 region=eu-west slice=0.5% status=running
oncall: Seeing p50 +15ms, p99 flat, no error-rate increase. :thumbsup:
sasha: Remember to save the slice mapping in Console: `slices/2024-04-01-new-llm-route`
marta: Abort instructions if needed: `deploybot abort --reason "<short>"` then `deploybot drain --to v3.2`
deploybot: holdpoint reached @1725500180 — current slice advancing to 5% pending hold verification. status=holding
tanya: Diff-eval: prompt-set B shows a 1.8% regression (threshold 2%). Flagging but still under cutoff.
raj: If that drifts >2.0% (e.g., 2.1%) we should trigger rollback immediately.
oncall: Agreed — I'll trigger abort if error-rate >0.5% for 3m OR eval >2% sustained. I'll post updates in the thread.
marta: Thanks. If all green at the 5% hold I'll proceed to 25% and keep the same SLO gates. Will publish short release notes after full rollout and add the changelog to the release channel. Tagging @sre @product for visibility.
deploybot: update: 5% step applied @1725500240 — status=running. Next holdpoint in 10m.
